vo_open.text: In 897, a pope dug up the previous pope.
And put his corpse on trial.

vo.text: Pope Formosus had been dead for about nine months, when Pope Stephen the Sixth had him dug up.
vo.cap: Dead for *9 months.* Then Pope Stephen VI had him *dug up.*

vo.text: The corpse was propped up on a throne. A deacon had to answer for him.
vo.cap: The corpse sat *on a throne.* A deacon *answered for him.*

vo.text: The verdict: guilty. His time as pope was declared null and void.
They cut off three fingers of his right hand, and threw the body into the Tiber.
vo.cap: *3 fingers* cut off. The body thrown into the *Tiber.*

vo.text: Rome turned against Stephen. That summer, he was strangled in prison.
vo.cap: Rome turned on Stephen. That summer, he was *strangled in prison.*
